title: Daily Life - This Is Your Captain Speaking

segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: And today we have a great lesson for all our upper intermediate students.
segments.zh: 今天，我们为所有中高级水平的学生准备了一节很棒的课。

segments.en: We're talking about airplane travel today.
segments.zh: 我们今天谈论的是飞机旅行。

segments.en: So we're going to be in an airplane.
And we're going to be listening to some of the common things you might hear on an announcement in the airplane.
segments.zh: 我们将在飞机上的公告中听到您可能听到的一些常见内容。

segments.en: Yeah, usually the flight attendant or the captain will come on and say something and well, usually it's in English, so we got to understand what they're saying.
segments.zh: 是的，通常空姐或机长会过来说些什么，而且，通常是英文的，所以我们必须理解他们在说什么。

segments.en: And we'll also learn some great phrases that you can use when you want to describe flights to your friends when you're talking to them.
segments.zh: 我们还将学习一些很棒的短语，当您想在与朋友交谈时向朋友描述航班时，您可以使用这些短语。

segments.en: You arrive somewhere and people are like, hey, how was your flight?
segments.zh: 你到达某个地方，人们就像，嘿，你的航班怎么样？

segments.en: Now you know how to answer it.
segments.zh: 现在你知道如何回答它了。

segments.en: So why don't we take a look at our vocabulary preview?
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不看看我们的词汇预览呢？

segments.en: Well, we've got three words for you here in vocabulary preview all about flying.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们在词汇预览中为您准备了三个单词关于飞行。
那么我们的第一个是什么？

segments.en: Well, turbulence when you're in an airplane basically is air that is moving in all directions really fast.
segments.zh: 好吧，坐飞机时遇到的气流颠簸，基本上就是空气快速地向四面八方乱窜。

segments.en: So the airplane will start to shake.
It's the same thing if you're flying a kite and maybe some turbulence is in the air, your kite will maybe fall to the ground.
segments.zh: 放风筝时也一样，如果空中有气流颠簸，风筝可能会掉到地上。

segments.en: So it's air that's moving in all directions.
segments.zh: 所以是空气向各个方向移动。

segments.en: Well, we'll hear how this word is used in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们将在对话中听到这个词是如何使用的。

segments.en: But another airplane word we hear a lot.
segments.zh: 但是我们经常听到的另一个飞机词。

segments.en: So the flight crew is basically the team.
segments.zh: 所以机组人员基本上是团队。

segments.en: It's all the people that are in the airplane.
So it's basically the captain and the co-pilot.
segments.zh: 所以基本上就是机长和副驾驶。

segments.en: So it's basically the flight crew.
segments.zh: 所以基本上是机组人员。

segments.en: And what about our last word?
So what would be an example of a bumpy ride?
segments.zh: 那“颠簸的旅程”能举个例子吗？

segments.en: Imagine if you're driving in your car and you're driving on a dirt road, like with many holes in it and everything.
segments.zh: 想象一下，如果你在车里开车，而你在土路上开车，就像里面有很多洞一样。

segments.en: You're driving on that road and it would be really, really bumpy.
segments.zh: 你在那条路上开车，它会非常非常颠簸。

segments.en: So your car will be moving a lot.
segments.zh: 所以你的车会移动很多。

segments.en: So a bumpy ride is a trip where you move and shake a lot.
segments.zh: 因此，颠簸的旅程是您经常移动和摇晃的旅行。

segments.en: So you can say, that is a bumpy road.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，那是一条崎岖不平的道路。

segments.en: Or it was a bumpy ride.
segments.zh: 或者这是一个颠簸的旅程。

segments.en: Or it was a bumpy ride.
segments.zh: 或者这是一个颠簸的旅程。

segments.en: So now let's listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们听听我们的对话。

segments.en: We're going to be listening to these people on an airplane and the captain is going to give some instructions.
segments.zh: 我们要听飞机上这些人的对话，机长会给出一些指示。

segments.en: And the next thing you know, we're running towards the...
segments.zh: 说时迟那时快，我们就朝着……跑去。

segments.en: We're just going through a bit of turbulence.
segments.zh: 只是遇到一点气流颠簸。

segments.en: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking.
It looks like we've hit a patch of rough air.
segments.zh: 看来飞机遇上了一段不稳定气流。

segments.en: So we're going to have a bit of a bumpy ride for the next several minutes.
segments.zh: 接下来几分钟可能会有些颠簸。

segments.en: This is why I hate flying.
segments.zh: 这就是我讨厌坐飞机的原因。

segments.en: At this time, I'd like to remind all of our passengers to fasten their seatbelts and remain seated until the fasten seatbelt sign is turned off.
segments.zh: 请各位乘客系好安全带，并留在座位上，直到安全带指示灯熄灭。

segments.en: Please ensure that all cabin baggage is carefully stowed under the seat in front of you.
segments.zh: 请把随身行李放好，置于前排座椅下方。

segments.en: I'll be back to update you in a minute.
segments.zh: 稍后我会再向大家通报情况。

segments.en: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain again.
We've got quite a large patch of rough air ahead of us.
segments.zh: 前方还有一大片强气流。

segments.en: And so for your safety, we will be suspending in-flight service.
segments.zh: 为安全起见，我们将暂停机上服务。

segments.en: I would ask all the in-flight crew to return to their seats at this time.
segments.zh: 请所有机组人员现在回到座位上。

segments.en: I would also ask that all our passengers refrain from using the lavatory until the seatbelt sign has been switched off.
segments.zh: 安全带指示灯熄灭前，请乘客不要使用洗手间。

segments.en: Well, here we are with another dramatic dialogue, another explosion in English.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们又来了一段戏剧性的对话，英语里又炸了一回。

segments.en: A lot of adventure is going on.

segments.zh: 所以我们会看看会发生什么。

segments.en: But I'm sure they're all right.
It's kind of making me nervous for my next flight.
segments.zh: 这有点让我在下一次飞行中感到紧张。

segments.en: So let's take a look at some of the words that the captain used in language takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看船长在语言要点中使用的一些词。

segments.en: All of these words you'll hear really, really often when you're flying.
segments.zh: 当你飞行时，你会经常听到的所有这些话。

segments.en: And the first one we have for you is fasten.
segments.zh: 我们讲的第一个词是 fasten。

segments.en: Now this is a great word.
segments.zh: 现在这是一个很棒的词。

segments.en: Do up or put on or...
So usually it'll be with a seatbelt or a belt or something like that, right?
segments.zh: 所以通常它会带安全带或安全带或类似的东西，对吧？

segments.en: Now the pronunciation here is interesting.
segments.zh: 现在这里的发音很有趣。

segments.en: The T kind of becomes silent.
segments.zh: T 的音差不多是不发的。

segments.en: Let's look at our next word.
So what is a lavatory exactly?
What's the difference between bathroom, restroom, washroom, WC, lavatory?
segments.zh: bathroom、restroom、washroom、WC、lavatory 这些词有什么区别？
洗手间这个词有这么多说法。

segments.en: A lavatory is a room with a toilet and sink only.
segments.zh: 厕所是一个只有厕所和水槽的房间。

segments.en: So it's very, very common to find a lavatory in boats, airplanes, or in trains.
segments.zh: 因此，在船、飞机或火车上找到厕所是非常非常普遍的。

segments.en: Even if your room in your house is only a sink and a toilet, it's still not a lavatory.
segments.zh: 即使你家里的房间只是一个水槽和一个厕所，它仍然不是一个厕所。

segments.en: That's just the way it is in English.
segments.zh: 这就是它在英语中的方式。

segments.en: And something interesting that you told me today, WC, right?
segments.zh: 你今天告诉我的一些有趣的事情，对吧？

segments.en: That's a common thing that you'll see on a bathroom.
segments.zh: 这是你在浴室里看到的常见事情。
water closet（盥洗室，WC 的全称）。
water closet（盥洗室，WC 的全称）。
water closet（盥洗室，WC 的全称）。

segments.en: Anyways, let's take a look at our next word.
segments.zh: 无论如何，让我们来看看我们的下一个词。

segments.en: So if I stow my luggage, it means?
segments.zh: 所以如果我收起我的行李，这意味着什么？

segments.en: You put it in a place where you can get it easily, but it is very safe.
segments.zh: 你把它放在一个你可以轻松拿到它的地方，但它是非常安全的。

segments.en: Maybe it's not even visible, right?
segments.zh: 也许它甚至不可见，对吧？

segments.en: So you put it away in a safe spot.
segments.zh: 所以你把它放在一个安全的地方。

segments.en: So usually in airplanes, they will tell you to stow your luggage under your seat.
segments.zh: 所以通常在飞机上，他们会告诉你把行李放在座位下。

segments.en: Or stow your luggage in the overhead bin.
segments.zh: 或将行李存放在头顶行李箱中。
头顶行李舱或头顶行李柜。

segments.en: So this is a verb, meaning avoid doing.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个动词，意思是避免做。

segments.en: Something interesting about this grammar-wise is it's usually followed by from.
segments.zh: 从语法上说，有趣的是它后面通常跟 from。

segments.en: And the verb that follows is always gerund, right?
segments.zh: 接下来的动词总是动名词，对吧？
所以是 refrain from + 动名词（-ing）。

segments.en: So some really great examples in language takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以一些非常好的例子在语言要点中。

segments.en: And well, now let's take a look at Fluency Builder and see some of these great phrases.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在让我们来看看流利表达并看看其中一些很棒的短语。

segments.en: Three phrases we have for you here.
segments.zh: 我们在这里为您准备的三个短语。

segments.en: This is really important in airplanes, right?
segments.zh: 这在飞机上真的很重要，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, because otherwise if there's turbulence, you could, you know, end up flying around the airplane.
segments.zh: 是的，因为否则如果有湍流，你可能会，你知道，最终会在飞机周围飞行。

segments.en: Or fall, exactly, and hurt yourself.
segments.zh: 或者，确切地说，伤害自己。

segments.en: Now, one of the reasons they had to remain seated was because they were going to go through a patch of rough air.
segments.zh: 他们必须留在座位上的原因之一，是即将遇到一段不稳定气流。

segments.en: So patch is a small area, right?
segments.zh: patch 就是一小片区域，对吧？

segments.en: So a small area of turbulence.
Now, what would be another example of patch?
segments.zh: 现在，补丁的另一个例子是什么？

segments.en: So it's like a little strawberry garden, right?
segments.zh: 所以它就像一个小草莓园，对吧？

segments.en: Usually in front of your house, you'll have a little patch of grass.
segments.zh: 通常在你家门前，你会有一小片草地。
现在是我们的最后一句话。

segments.en: So stop for a short time.
So you could suspend your work.
segments.zh: 所以你可以暂停你的工作。

segments.en: And if you're going on vacation, you could suspend your subscription to the newspaper.
segments.zh: 如果你要去度假，你可以暂停订阅报纸。

segments.en: So we've covered a lot of vocabulary and some great phrases.
segments.zh: 所以我们已经涵盖了很多词汇和一些很棒的短语。

segments.en: And the next thing you know, we're running towards the.

segments.en: We're just going through a bit of turbulence.

segments.en: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking.
It looks like we've hit a patch of rough air.
segments.zh: 看来飞机遇上了一段不稳定气流。

segments.en: So we're going to have a bit of a bumpy ride for the next several minutes.

segments.en: At this time, I'd like to remind all our passengers to fasten their seat belts and remain seated until the fasten seat belt sign is turned off.
segments.zh: 此时，我想提醒我们的所有乘客系好安全带并保持就座，直到系紧安全带标志关闭。

segments.en: Erica, have you ever had a turbulent flight like this?
segments.zh: 埃里卡，你有没有像这样动荡的飞行？
不，不，从来没有这么糟糕。

segments.en: Actually, I kind of like turbulent flights.
segments.zh: 其实我还有点喜欢颠簸的飞行。

segments.en: It's sort of like, I don't know, it's kind of fun.
segments.zh: 这有点像，我不知道，这很有趣。

segments.en: You get shaken around and your stomach moves up and down.
segments.zh: 你被摇晃，你的胃上下移动。

segments.en: No, I get a little excited.
Well, it is true that flying is actually very, very safe, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，飞行实际上非常非常安全，对吧？

segments.en: I know we all hear that more people are killed in car accidents than flight accidents.
segments.zh: 我知道我们都听说在车祸中丧生的人多于飞行事故。

segments.en: So yeah, I don't worry about the turbulence.

segments.en: But yeah, so flying is really safe and you know, as long as you remain seated, you fasten your seat belt and you, you know, you follow the instructions, you shouldn't have any problems.

segments.en: Actually, that's a really good point because actually when I was reading about flight turbulence for this dialogue, I kept reading all these stories about these people who, you know, when they got into some turbulent air were, you know, knocked over or they ended up like actually literally flying through the cabin and getting really badly hurt.
segments.zh: 其实这一点说得很对，因为我在为这段对话查飞行颠簸的资料时，不停看到这样的故事：这些人遇到颠簸气流时，你知道，被撞倒，甚至真的整个人飞过客舱，受了重伤。
